name: triage-assessment
title: Emergency Triage Assessment
description: Emergency Severity Index (ESI 1-5) clinical triage decision tool with vitals overview, acuity reassessment timers, and bed assignment.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Activity, AlertCircle, AlertTriangle, Bed, CheckCircle2, Clock, Flame, Heart, HeartPulse, Siren, Stethoscope, Timer, User, } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label" import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea" import { ClinicalStatusBadge, type ClinicalStatus } from "@/components/medicn/clinical-status-badge" export type EsiLevel = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 export interface EsiCriteria { immediateLifeThreat?: boolean highRisk?: boolean severePain?: boolean confusedLethargic?: boolean resourceCount?: number } export interface TriageVitals { hr?: number bp?: string rr?: number spo2?: number temp?: number pain?: number } export interface TriageData { patientName: string chiefComplaint: string esiLevel: EsiLevel vitals?: TriageVitals triageNotes?: string assignedBed?: string triagedAt?: string triageNurse?: string } export const ESI_LEVELS: Record< EsiLevel, { level: EsiLevel label: string description: string clinicalStatus: ClinicalStatus colorClass: string reassessmentInterval: string } > = { 1: { level: 1, label: "Resuscitation", description: "Immediate life-saving intervention needed without delay. Unresponsive, intubated, pulseless, or severe respiratory distress.", clinicalStatus: "critical", colorClass: "border-clinical-critical bg-clinical-critical text-white", reassessmentInterval: "Continuous nursing presence", }, 2: { level: 2, label: "Emergent", description: "High-risk situation, confused / lethargic / disoriented, or severe pain / distress (pain ≥ 7/10).", clinicalStatus: "critical", colorClass: "border-clinical-critical/40 bg-clinical-critical/10 text-clinical-critical", reassessmentInterval: "Every 15 minutes", }, 3: { level: 3, label: "Urgent", description: "Requires two or more projected resources (labs + imaging, IV meds, specialty consult). Vitals in danger zone require up-triage.", clinicalStatus: "abnormal", colorClass: "border-clinical-abnormal/40 bg-clinical-abnormal/10 text-clinical-abnormal", reassessmentInterval: "Every 30 minutes", }, 4: { level: 4, label: "Less Urgent", description: "Requires one projected diagnostic or therapeutic resource (e.g. single X-ray, simple suture, oral meds).", clinicalStatus: "normal", colorClass: "border-clinical-normal/40 bg-clinical-normal/10 text-clinical-normal", reassessmentInterval: "Every 60 minutes", }, 5: { level: 5, label: "Non-Urgent", description: "Requires no projected resources (e.g. routine prescription refill, suture removal, minor rash, normal exam).", clinicalStatus: "info", colorClass: "border-clinical-info/40 bg-clinical-info/10 text-clinical-info", reassessmentInterval: "Every 120 minutes", }, } export function getEsiLevelInfo(level: number) { const safeLevel = (level >= 1 && level <= 5 ? level : 3) as EsiLevel return ESI_LEVELS[safeLevel] } export function recommendEsiLevel(criteria: EsiCriteria): EsiLevel { if (criteria.immediateLifeThreat) return 1 if (criteria.highRisk || criteria.severePain || criteria.confusedLethargic) return 2 if (criteria.resourceCount != null) { if (criteria.resourceCount >= 2) return 3 if (criteria.resourceCount === 1) return 4 return 5 } return 3 } export interface TriageAssessmentProps extends Omit, "title"> { patientName?: string mrn?: string chiefComplaint?: string defaultLevel?: EsiLevel vitals?: TriageVitals triageNurse?: string onTriage?: (data: TriageData) => void readOnly?: boolean title?: React.ReactNode } export function TriageAssessment({ patientName = "Patient Name", mrn = "MRN-39182", chiefComplaint: initialChiefComplaint = "", defaultLevel = 3, vitals = { hr: 88, bp: "128/82", rr: 16, spo2: 98, temp: 98.6, pain: 4 }, triageNurse = "R. Davis, BSN, RN", onTriage, readOnly = false, title = "Emergency Triage Assessment", className, ...props }: TriageAssessmentProps) { const [esiLevel, setEsiLevel] = React.useState(defaultLevel) const [chiefComplaint, setChiefComplaint] = React.useState(initialChiefComplaint) const [triageNotes, setTriageNotes] = React.useState("") const [assignedBed, setAssignedBed] = React.useState("Waiting Room 1") const levelInfo = getEsiLevelInfo(esiLevel) const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => { e.preventDefault() onTriage?.({ patientName, chiefComplaint, esiLevel, vitals, triageNotes, assignedBed, triageNurse, triagedAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }), }) } return (
